name: Sorong

queries.query: Sorong Indonesia official cadastral parcel map service ATR BPN Geoportal
queries.result: Found the official ATR/BPN BHUMI interactive map and ATLAS geospatial portal. The official Sorong city government also reports that Kota Sorong is a Kota Lengkap with all land parcels digitally mapped and identifies the local BPN office.

queries.query: Sorong Indonesia peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN layanan
queries.result: Found official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS documentation and an official Sorong city government report naming Kantor Pertanahan Kota Sorong and stating that all land parcels in the city have been digitally mapped. No anonymous parcel geometry response was available.

officialSources.operator: Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
officialSources.evidence: Official public BHUMI map route; current JavaScript and configuration were retrieved over verified TLS.
Official ATLAS portal; anonymous GeoNode resource listing returned seven published national datasets, none exposing a public Sorong parcel dataset.
Official city-government report dated 2025-08-15 identifies the BPN Kota Sorong office and states Kota Sorong is a Kota Lengkap, with all land parcels digitally mapped.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official public map HTML and current JavaScript configuration retrieved.

Anonymous published-layer metadata retrieved. Bidang Tanah is configured as vendor Geoserver, service /bhumigs/umum, layer umum:Persil, with safe display fields penggunaan, tipehak, luas, nib, and akurasibidang; metadata update 2026-09-21.
Anonymous ATLAS GeoNode resource listing returned seven public resources; no Sorong-specific or parcel geometry dataset was exposed.
Current public route returned BHUMI application HTML/404 rather than WFS capabilities; no schema or CRS document retained.
Bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry request returned BHUMI application HTML/404; no parcel hit or citywide absence inferred.

fieldMapping.nib: Native Nomor Identifikasi Bidang field exposed by current published Bidang Tanah metadata; no feature value retrieved.
fieldMapping.geometry: Parcel polygon geometry expected from configured umum:Persil layer; no usable feature response obtained.

sourceIdentity.crs: Not confirmed from a usable feature response; no transformation applied.
sourceIdentity.geometryType: Not confirmed from a usable feature response.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Sorong city-government evidence says Kota Sorong is a Kota Lengkap with all parcels digitally mapped; ATR/BPN publishes a national Bidang Tanah layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry/custodian and citywide digital-mapping claim evidenced, but open parcel feature coverage was not independently verified from anonymous geometry.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No usable feature response was obtained. This is a public endpoint limitation, not evidence of parcel absence.

remainingUncertainty: The local registry/custodian is evidenced by official city-government reporting, but the current public BHUMI proxy did not expose anonymous WFS capabilities or parcel geometry. CRS, feature schema beyond safe metadata, NIB stability in returned features, and exact city coverage remain unverified. No owner or title data were accessed.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently test the current BHUMI map/API route, CRS, Sorong coverage, and NIB-safe feature response before any adapter admission.
